global_caption: The video contains 10 shots and is a low-saturation watercolor picture book-style short film set in a medieval magic castle, depicting an experiment. The overall lighting combines warm candlelight and cool colored flames into a unified visual tone, with subdued and soft colors. The The overall mood is serene curiosity with a touch of uplifting emotion.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in from black, a wide overhead shot of the medieval castle tower at night. Foreground features blurred stone eaves and vines, background shows deep blue sky and thin clouds. Focus is on the gently flickering orange-red light from a high window in the tower. Low-saturation watercolor edges make the stone texture appear softly diffused like paper in a picture book. Cold night surrounds the warm glow. The camera slowly pushes forward along the tower wall, drawing viewers toward the glowing window.
shot2: Shot 2 hard cuts from previous shot to interior of the castle, a full shot eye-level capturing a boy walking through a narrow corridor toward the alchemy table. Arched stone columns frame both sides, forming leading lines. Old bricks on the floor reflect candlelight. Occasionally, a wall sconce passes through foreground, creating soft obstruction. Focus remains steady on the small bottle he holds and his steps. Warm candlelight remains dominant, while faint cold blue reflections are visible from the far end of the lab. The camera performs smooth lateral tracking, conveying spatial continuity from corridor to alchemy room.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions from previous shot with brief fade to close-up overhead view focusing on the alchemy table surface. On the wooden table are several small bottles, salt powders, metal spoons, and a small furnace. Foreground shows blurred edge of a half-open wooden box. Focus shifts slowly from labeled bottle tops to the boy’s fingers as he arranges powder in neat piles. Powder particles retain dry, fine texture even under watercolor rendering. The furnace is not yet lit. Candlelight from side-rear highlights subtle surface undulations. The camera uses extremely slow overhead drift and slight focus shift to present the precise sequence of preparation.
shot4: Shot 4 hard cuts from previous shot to close-up eye-level shot. The furnace opening occupies center-lower frame. The boy brings an ignition tool near the wick. Foreground shows a small pile of unused powder blurred into pale patches. The first orange flame leaps up instantly upon contact, sparks briefly scatter then quickly retract. Warm light immediately overwhelms the dim surroundings, illuminating his fingertips and furnace rim. The camera makes a brief push-in, locking onto the instant the flame forms.
shot5: Shot 5 transitions from previous shot via action match to macro close-up overhead view. The boy gently sprinkles the first type of powder into the orange flame. Shallow depth of field makes the powder’s trajectory into the flame the absolute focal point. Originally orange flame rapidly turns green and curls upward. Color change starts from base and spreads to tip. Warm candlelight still casts soft shadows in background.
shot6: Shot 6 hard cuts from previous shot to close-up eye-level shot. Another small spoon delivers copper salt to the edge of the small furnace. Foreground shows blurred blue-gray outline of a glass bottle. Focus is on the slender flame tongue. New flame shows colder blue at root and extends higher and thinner, gently swaying in air currents. Flame edges are transparent, center brighter, forming a clear and continuous experimental progression from previous green flame. Environment remains dual illumination of candlelight and colored flames. Gentle glass and metal clinks interject. Camera performs very controlled lateral micro-move, making blue flame appear to glide quietly within frame.
shot7: Shot 7 transitions from previous shot with soft fade to medium overhead view. Multiple small bottles are neatly arranged on wooden table. Flame tongues in different furnaces vary in height. Orange, green, and blue flames create layered rhythmic progression on same surface. Foreground shows unopened bottle stopper. Background features softly blurred stone wall and pages. Focus centers on silhouette of staggered flame tips. Overhead composition makes experimental order immediately clear. Candlelight warms wood grain. Colored flames cast alternating warm and cool shadows on table. Camera performs slow overhead drift, scanning left to right across entire row of flames, ensuring each form is fully visible.
shot8: Shot 8 hard cuts from previous shot to close-up eye-level slightly overhead angle. Boy lifts glass cover from top of frame and slowly lowers it over one flame. Foreground shows reflection on transparent glass edge. Background is blurred bookshelf and stone wall. Focus locks on flame shape changing within cover. Originally scattered flame gradually becomes narrower, straighter, and more stable under cover. Blue-green light spots shimmer on glass surface. Emotion here slightly pauses. Camera performs slight downward tilt and push-in, emphasizing observation action and subtle changes in constrained flame.
shot9: Frame focuses on boy’s face. He slightly raises head, watching flame color inside glass cover. Blue, green, and red reflections successively illuminate his cheeks, eyelashes, and eyes. Occasional out-of-focus flame tongue passes through foreground, naturally linking character and experimental result. Background alchemy room recedes into soft color blocks. Candlelight maintains warm base tone on skin. Colored flames leave dreamy, controlled cool highlights on face.
shot10: Shot 10 transitions from previous shot with fade-in/fade-out to wide full shot eye-level with slight pull-back. Entire alchemy room appears like a quiet page from a picture book. Stone walls, candle stands, wooden tables, medicine bottles, books, and several still-gently-flickering colored flames are fully framed. Composition centers alchemy table slightly forward, with night outside tower window in distant background. A stationary glass cover in foreground echoes earlier scene. Focus expands gradually from person and flames to entire room, restoring calmness. Warm candlelight and cool flame light continue to unify the scene. Camera slowly pulls back and slightly elevates, freezing the entire lab in low-saturation watercolor texture as a tranquil and mysterious conclusion.
